name: mirage
text: Not really. BoltOdds' odds socket is used live (live lines, flagged in-play games), but live SCORES are not: they are a separate Live Play-by-Play and Scores product that is not in your Pro plan (BOLTODDS_API.md). The /livescores socket accepted a subscription on your key but I never saw a score frame, because no game was live during the test, so the app does not read it. Live scores come from ESPN and, since v1.0.11, SX Bet. Next step (CH29a, open): in a live game, run Test key and send me the file; I read the real frame shape and, if it carries scores, wire it in behind ESPN.
